professionalSummary.text: Pricing Analyst with three years of experience in the motor pricing team of a personal lines insurer, specializing in refreshing rating factors, preparing rate change proposals, and managing pricing model monitoring.
professionalSummary.witness: Pricing analyst in the motor pricing team of a personal lines insurer for three years, refreshing the rating factors from the claims and quote data each quarter under the team's refresh procedure.

experienceHighlights.text: Refreshed rating factors quarterly from claims and quote data under the team's established refresh procedure.
experienceHighlights.witness: refreshing the rating factors from the claims and quote data each quarter under the team's refresh procedure.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared eleven rate change proposals with impact analysis, all approved or amended by the pricing committee with decisions recorded on proposals.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared eleven rate change proposals with their impact analysis; each was approved or amended by the pricing committee, with the committee's decision recorded on the proposal.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran monthly pricing model monitoring, raising three drift cases to the actuarial team, documented in the monitoring log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the pricing model monitoring each month and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team, recorded in the monitoring log.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly pricing packs for the pricing committee, explicitly documenting ownership of analyses within the pack.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly pricing pack for the pricing committee, recording in the pack which analyses were mine and which came from the actuarial team.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented limitations and hand-over conditions for each rate change proposal.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each rate change proposal.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a rate change proposal with impact analysis, committee decision record, monthly pricing pack, and monitoring log extract with repository references as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one rate change proposal with its impact analysis and the committee decision record, one monthly pricing pack and the monitoring log extract for the three drift cases, with the pricing repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Pricing model monitoring, rate change proposal preparation, impact analysis, documentation of limitations and hand-over conditions.
skills.witness: Ran the pricing model monitoring each month and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team, recorded in the monitoring log.

evidence.text: Pricing analyst in the motor pricing team of a personal lines insurer for three years, refreshing the rating factors from the claims and quote data each quarter under the team's refresh procedure.
Prepared eleven rate change proposals with their impact analysis; each was approved or amended by the pricing committee, with the committee's decision recorded on the proposal.
Ran the pricing model monitoring each month and raised three drift cases to the actuarial team, recorded in the monitoring log.
Prepared the monthly pricing pack for the pricing committee, recording in the pack which analyses were mine and which came from the actuarial team.
Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each rate change proposal.
